label: SET::NUP214

sections.text: SET encodes a chromatin-associated protein and inhibitor of protein phosphatase 2A.
NUP214 encodes a nuclear pore component involved in nucleocytoplasmic transport.

The fusion produces a SET-containing NUP214 protein that perturbs nuclear-export-associated transcription and is linked to HOXA activation. It is found in immature T-lineage leukemia and some AML cases.
